content:
Here's a comprehensive NCLEX preparation todo list:

Study Preparation:
1. Purchase review books
- Kaplan NCLEX review
- Saunders Comprehensive Review
- UWorld NCLEX prep

2. Create study schedule
- Daily study blocks
- Consistent routine
- Specific subject focus

3. Content Review
- Medical-Surgical Nursing
- Pediatric Nursing
- Maternity Nursing
- Mental Health Nursing
- Pharmacology
- Fundamental nursing concepts

4. Practice Questions
- UWorld question bank
- NCLEX practice tests
- Kaplan question bank
- Simple Nursing questions
- LaCharity priority questions

5. Test-Taking Strategy Skills
- Learn question breakdown techniques
- Practice prioritization questions
- Master select all that apply (SATA)
- Understand alternate format questions

6. Mental Preparation
- Stress management techniques
- Meditation
- Regular exercise
- Healthy diet
- Consistent sleep schedule

7. Final Preparation
- Schedule exam
- Confirm testing center location
- Gather required documents
- Practice relaxation techniques
- Review quick reference sheets

8. Exam Day Preparation
- Rest well night before
- Eat balanced breakfast
- Arrive early
- Bring required identification

Recommended study time: 4-8 weeks

Good luck!
